assessment.scope: Selected ILCD2011 and UNEP2019 original passages, EF explanatory reports/official-format documentation and eight identity-checked official archive members. Roy and underlying AE works retain their actual author-abstract/preview scope; no full-paper upgrade, whole-ZIP rehash, EF3.0 replay or2019 GLAM workbook verification is asserted.
assessment.comparison: AE explicitly concerns receiving critical-load exceedance in its European modeled domain. The2019 SO2-equivalent terrestrial pathway and later scoping account retain their component-placement tension. Atmospheric, soil and plant components are identifiable, but the uninspected workbook is not reconstructed or labeled deposition-only. A published description and actual factor implementation have different evidence.
assessment.facts: Six exact method rows fix chemical UUID/version, Output, air class, country and kg denominator. SO2 CZ2.12 versus AL0.032 rejects a chemistry-only reconstruction of both rows. NH3 acid3.655/0.021 and terrestrial10.328/7.192 fail a single inter-category multiplier at these two locations, with cross-products0.216888 and26.286760. Neither result numerically tests EF-to-GLAM conversion or real damage. JRC-specific NO/SO3 chemical proxy conversion remains a valid conditional counterexample to a blanket prohibition.
assessment.identity: The two Mass reference chains reach the original kg reference. The two methods declare H+ and N equivalents and share Moles; the explicit mole-group reference03.00.000 versus retrieved03.00.003 discrepancy remains visible and does not establish importer resolution. Country is exchange/emission location, not a single recipient or all impact occurring domestically.
assessment.conservation: All927 prior claim records, original15 B16 occurrences, headings/markers and phosphorus input remain. Eight new claims, seven source entries,26 evidence records and six numeric facts use bounded original-reading extensions and an appended EF-work source pointer. No numerical case, registry or dependency change.
assessment.review: Fresh original-source/design and data checks preceded the main draft and its exact integration.
